title: Codex app-server notifications TermAl does not handle: thread/goal/cleared, thread/settings/updated, thread/readState/changed, turn/moderationMetadata, account/updated
outcome: TermAl's Codex adapter recognises current Codex app-server notifications, handles the ones that matter, and ignores the rest deliberately without logging them as unhandled. account/updated, which carries no thread id, is accepted as a global event.
acceptance: Each of the five notifications is classified, from the Codex protocol, as handled, ignored or global, and the adapter's dispatch reflects that classification.
A regression test feeds each notification to the adapter and asserts that no unhandled-event or missing-thread-id warning is logged.
